verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an accounting/invoicing SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a self-hostable distribution, installer, or source release of the core product. Everything described, including the REST API at moneybird.com/api/v2, the MCP, the CLI and the sandbox administrations, runs on Moneybird's hosted service. A published OpenAPI spec is an API-description building block, not a self-hosted product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
